content: Freelancers: the fix for scope creep isn't arguing — it's writing exclusions BEFORE deliverables. Free guide: the exclusions-first SOW method (change-order pricing in advance, revision counter, 2 pushback sentences that end awkward talks): https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/guide-freelancer-scope-control.html — full method free, no email needed. We also sell a $39 template kit; the guide stands alone.
